## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## 🎯 Target Stakeholders
Which stakeholder group(s) benefit from this feature? (e.g., Students, Teachers, Parents, School Admins).

## 💡 Rationale & User Impact
Why is this feature required? What problem does it solve?

## 📝 Proposed Implementation Specs
Any architectural, UI, or API specifications to guide implementation.
